_comment: Runtime configuration for the wiki-ingester worker, read by the SPAWNER (wiki-cycle or an interactive session) BEFORE launching workers — not by the worker itself. model_default: any model name the harness's Agent tool accepts (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku', 'fable' — update freely as new models release; this file exists precisely so a model change is a config edit, not an agent-definition edit). confirm_model_each_run: false (the default since 2026-10-22, task #199) = the spawner uses model_default without asking, wiki-cycle Step 2 sends long transcripts to Opus by its length rule, and the spawn receipt names the models used; it asks only when the user asked to choose the model for that run (three cycles in a row asked, every answer was the default, and the question blocked a run while Mark was away). true = the spawner asks the user which model to use for this batch, offering model_default as the default, WHEN the session can ask (interactive); a session that cannot ask (autonomous / unattended / a scheduled run) uses model_default without asking and names the model it used in its spawn receipt (2026-09-13, defect 5 of the 2026-09-12 batch). The chosen model is passed as the Agent tool's spawn-time 'model' override. Fallback if this file is missing or unread: the AGENT.md frontmatter (model: sonnet).
